applicationWiring.preflightOrder: ConfigReader.Load -> TargetForm -> DXManager.Create -> GameUiStartupSession.Prepare -> sound/login scene -> message pump
applicationWiring.failurePolicy: Invalid style, blocked compiled gate or failed full package preflight creates a Legacy session with no package; diagnostic recorded by Program through CEnvir.SaveError.
applicationWiring.ownership: Startup/render thread owns one package lease for application lifetime; scene candidates only borrow; selection snapshots config and never hot-switches.
applicationWiring.shutdown: Message pump stopped -> active scene Dispose -> connection Unload -> startup package Dispose -> DXManager.Unload -> DXSoundManager.Unload. Nested finally retains cleanup on save/scene/connection failures.
applicationWiring.productionActivation: Preflight is wired in Program, but there is no startup caller that invokes InstallOfficialWindowCandidate. Complete scene enable/failure handling and runtime input fault containment remain pending.
